title: Federal Rule 21 — misjoinder and nonjoinder
summary: Joinder determines which claims and persons can be included in one action. Different devices govern multiple claims, counterclaims, crossclaims, additional defendants, required parties, interpleader, and intervention.

sections.Role in the course: Joinder determines which claims and persons can be included in one action. Different devices govern multiple claims, counterclaims, crossclaims, additional defendants, required parties, interpleader, and intervention.
sections.What to examine: Identify who is asserting the claim against whom, the relevant rule, the required factual relationship, and whether joinder is optional or required. Then separately establish subject-matter jurisdiction, personal jurisdiction, service, and venue as applicable.
